村头！

太阳开始渐渐西斜，田间地头的水稻苗子，耷拉着的叶子缓缓伸直抬起，散去了一天的炎热。

“你个扫把星，怎么还不做饭？”

“也不看看这都几点了？”

赵贵婆娘走到王乃香的狗窝前，开口大骂道。

王乃香连忙从小狗窝内爬出来，脸上尽显疲惫之色，刚刚搬到这里后，一切都要重新布置，比如说锅碗瓢配什么的，还要临时搭了个小灶台，这可是大活，赵贵老两口早早的就在草房子里躺着歇息了，赵强那个小叔子更是什么都不管。

家里的一切操持，都要王乃香一个人来。

刚刚忙活完，刚想着躺在小狗窝里面休息一下，却不曾想，又被赵贵的婆娘叫起来做饭。

赵强好吃懒做。

家里那点收成，根本就不够吃的，所以只能吃最差的地瓜，晒干的地瓜干，这是最穷的人家才会吃的，毕竟这东西产量高。

添柴，引火，烧水……！

地瓜干放进去熬煮，没多久，锅里便咕噜咕噜开了锅，一股地瓜的味道飘出来。

“娘，饭做好了！”

王乃香将一碗碗地瓜干粥做好后，用勺子舀到碗里，对着赵贵夫妻俩和赵强喊了一声道。

“磨磨蹭蹭的，怎么现在才做好？”

赵贵婆娘骂骂咧咧的走了出来，坐在桌子上吃饭，因为椅子不够，柳桂香只能蹲在一旁吃。

“怎么又吃这东西？”赵强望着碗里的地瓜干粥，脸上闪过一抹不爽骂道。

“家里……家里只有地瓜干了……！”王乃香温声细语道。

“家里只有地瓜干，你不能去想想办法吗？”

“天天吃这玩意，谁受得了？”

赵强见王乃香竟然敢顶撞自己，心中更加不爽道：“还有，在这个家有你一个扫把星说话的份吗？我们说什么，你就老老实实听着，去照做！”

王乃香低下头去，不再言语。

“娘，我想了想！”

“你们觉得咱们村赵瞎子怎么样？”

赵强看向赵贵夫妻俩，开口问道。

“赵瞎子咋了？什么怎么样？”赵贵微微一怔，好奇道。

“爹，你怎么这么糊涂？”

“赵瞎子不是单身汉吗？”

“老光棍了，这辈子都没找过女人，他不是年轻的时候伤了眼睛，瞎了一只眼吗？”

“结果，就没有女人看得上他，一直单身到现在！”

Village head!

The sun began to set gradually in the west, and the drooping leaves of the rice seedlings in the fields slowly straightened and lifted up, dissipating the heat of the day.

"You idiot, why don't you cook?"

"Don't you know what time it is?"

Mrs. Zhao Gui walked to Wang Naixiang's kennel and cursed.

Wang Naixiang quickly crawled out of the puppy's kennel, with a look of exhaustion on her face. After just moving here, everything had to be rearranged, such as the pots and pans, and a temporary stove. This was a big job. Zhao Gui and his wife had already laid down and rested in the thatched house, and Zhao Qiang's brother-in-law didn't care about anything.

Wang Naixiang has to handle all the household chores alone.

He had just finished his work and was about to lie down in the puppy's kennel and take a rest, but unexpectedly, Zhao Gui's mother-in-law called him up to cook again.

Zhao Qiang loves to eat and is lazy to cook.

The small harvest at home is not enough to eat, so we can only eat the worst sweet potatoes, dried sweet potatoes, which are only eaten by the poorest families. After all, this product has a high yield.

Add firewood, light the fire, boil water...!

Put the dried sweet potatoes in and boil them. After a while, the pot began to simmer, and the smell of sweet potatoes wafted out.

"Mom, the meal is ready!"

After Wang Naixiang prepared bowls of dried sweet potato porridge, she scooped it into the bowl with a spoon and shouted to Zhao Gui, his wife and Zhao Qiang.

"It took so long, why can't it be done now?"

Mrs. Zhao Gui came out cursing and sat at the table to eat. Because there were not enough chairs, Liu Guixiang could only squat aside and eat.

"Why are you eating this again?" Zhao Qiang looked at the dried sweet potato porridge in the bowl and cursed with a flash of displeasure on his face.

"At home... there are only dried sweet potatoes at home...!" Wang Naixiang whispered softly.

"We only have dried sweet potatoes at home, can't you think of something to do?"

"Who can bear to eat this stuff every day?"

Seeing that Wang Naixiang dared to contradict him, Zhao Qiang felt even more unhappy and said, "Also, do you have the right to speak as a broomstick in this family? Just listen to what we say and do it!"

Wang Naixiang lowered his head and said nothing.

"Mom, I thought about it!"

"What do you think of our village's blind man Zhao?"

Zhao Qiang looked at Zhao Gui and his wife and asked.

"What's wrong with Blind Zhao? What's wrong?" Zhao Gui was slightly startled and asked curiously.

"Dad, why are you so confused?"

"Isn't Blind Zhao a bachelor?"

"He is an old bachelor. He has never found a woman in his life. Didn't he hurt his eye when he was young and become blind in one eye?"

"As a result, no woman likes him, and he has been single until now!"
